# AI Index Optimizer

> AI visibility audits and fixes for SEO agencies: see exactly why ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity ignore a site, then fix crawler access, llms.txt, robots.txt, schema and metadata.

## What it does

- AI crawler access audit: shows whether GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended and other crawlers are blocked by robots.txt, a firewall or a login wall.
- llms.txt and robots.txt generation: produces the access files that let assistants discover and read the site, ready to deploy.
- Schema and metadata audit: checks titles, descriptions, headings and structured data that decide whether a page can be quoted in an AI answer.
- Per-provider AI visibility: reports what ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity each see, provider by provider, and what to fix first.

## Pricing

- Free: $0/mo, 1 domain, full audit and visibility score.
- Starter: $39/mo, 3 domains, unlimited rescans, crawler rules and access file deployment.
- Growth: $99/mo, 10 domains, branded reports, page-level rules and crawl analytics.
- Agency: $299/mo, 30 domains, white-label reports, bulk scans and priority support.
